The UE transmit frequency hopping is configured within one SRS resource for positioning, that may be configured with a bandwidth larger than the maximum bandwidth of the UE, in RRC_CONNECTED or RRC_INACTIVE mode. The UE transmit frequency hopping, may be configured with overlapping or non-overlapping frequency hops in the frequency domain.
